name: Talia Reyes
source:
Raised on a bustling trade hub station where she grew up bartering and bluffing in her family's merchant business. She collects alien trinkets, antique junk, and bizarre off-world snacks like trophies from a life spent haggling. Though she shares history with [url=/c166741]Veronica[/url] and [url=/c166738]Liv[/url], she openly despises Veronica and doesn't bother hiding it.
